movie.title: Fortune House
movie.overview: A desperate immigrant delivery driver stumbles into a mahjong parlor run by three demons, where he enters a demon’s deal: win the game, and they will grant him a green card.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Desperate for legal status, an immigrant delivery driver plays a high-stakes mahjong game against three demons who promise him a green card if he wins.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: In Fortune House, a struggling immigrant delivery driver hits rock bottom in his search for legal security and peace of mind. While making a late-night delivery, he accidentally stumbles into a hidden mahjong parlor run by three demonic entities. To earn the ultimate reward—a magically guaranteed green card—he agrees to enter a high-stakes game against them. Blending dark comedy, supernatural fantasy, and heartfelt drama, his journey becomes a surreal battle of wits where winning means freedom and losing costs far more than money.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Life is a relentless struggle for a hard-working immigrant delivery driver trying to build a stable life in a foreign land. Facing constant financial instability and the persistent threat of deportation, his sheer desperation leads him into a mysterious, late-night mahjong parlor. Inside, he realizes the establishment is run by three trickster demons who bargain with human desires. Recognizing his burning wish for stability, the demons present him with a Faustian offer: defeat them in a game of mahjong, and they will grant him a green card. Driven by hope and left with no other alternatives, he sits at the supernatural game table. As the game progresses, each round becomes an intense psychological battle filled with supernatural illusions, sharp banter, and dramatic twists. The demons manipulate the tiles and test not just his strategy, but his moral integrity and core values. To survive the game and secure his future, he must outwit ancient beings using his own life experience, resilience, and sharp instincts.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Fortune House is a genre-blending fantasy comedy-drama that explores the anxieties of the immigrant experience through a magical, modern-day parable. The narrative follows a dedicated delivery driver burdened by the overwhelming difficulty of securing legal status. When a chance encounter brings him face-to-face with three ancient demons operating a secret mahjong parlor, he is offered a surreal bargain to win his green card. Combining supernatural stakes with sharp comedic timing and dramatic heart, Fortune House examines how far one will go to achieve a place to call home, pitting human perseverance against demonic cunning.

story_structure.climax: With the final tiles on the board and defeat looming, the driver reaches a breaking point where he must execute a perilous risk, pitting his human cunning and morality against the supernatural trickery of his opponents.
story_structure.conflict: While on a delivery, he stumbles into a hidden mahjong parlor run by three demonic entities and accepts a high-stakes supernatural gamble: win the game to earn a green card, or suffer dire demonic consequences.
story_structure.resolution: The high-stakes game reaches its definitive end, forever altering the driver's destiny and forcing him to live with the profound true cost of his desperate dream.
story_structure.introduction: A struggling immigrant delivery driver, desperate to secure his legal status and build a stable future, navigates the harsh pressures and isolation of his daily routine.
story_structure.risingAction: As the ethereal game unfolds, the driver must decipher supernatural rules while enduring the demons' psychological mind games, escalating temptational traps, and terrifying illusions designed to make him forfeit.
